subject: english-literature
title: Mapping the Structure
welcome_lead: Put the terms together and analyse a whole story's shape.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on mapping structure terms onto a story.
final_note: You can now label a story's structure end-to-end.

concepts.def: Events that happened before the story.
Moment that changes the plot direction.
Peak of tension in the plot.

walkthroughs.body_html: A turning point swings the story in a new direction. The climax is the biggest, but smaller turning points appear throughout.
Pacing = speed. Short sentences and quick scenes accelerate; long descriptions slow things down for tension.
Backstory tells us what came before. Foreshadowing hints at what's coming. Together they shape expectation.
